messages:
Anya Patel: ran a quick sweep for sierra14b quant profiles across H100 (us-east-1) and A100 (ap-southeast-1). short findings: fp8 gives ~2.1x p99 throughput uplift on H100; int8 ~1.9x on A100. quality regressions small on our instruction-following eval: fp8 ~ -0.6 to -0.9% absolute, int8 ~ -1.3 to -1.8%.

Rajesh Nair: nice. can you paste the raw numbers and the exact config (batch, seq, kernels)?

Anya Patel: sure — command used and config snippet:```bash
run_bench --model sierra14b --quant-profile fp16,bf16,int8,fp8 \
  --gpus h100,a100 --regions us-east-1,ap-southeast-1 \
  --batch-sizes 1,4,8 --seq-lens 512,1024 --kernels fused_attention,mha_opt \
  --kv-cache warmup=3 --eval-set instr-follow-v2 --save /tmp/sierra_q/```
notes: fp8 = per-channel symmetric + 8-bit exponent hack; int8 = per-tensor static with calibration set of 2k prompts. kernels chosen by runtime AUTOPICK but we also pinned mha_opt for a few runs.```

Lucas Kim: pasting the core sweep CSV (condensed):
```
region,gpu,precision,tokens_s,p99_ms,throughput_rps,quality_delta
us-east-1,H100,FP16,32000,12.8,520,0.0%
us-east-1,H100,FP8,69000,7.1,1120,-0.7%
us-east-1,H100,INT8,61000,8.2,980,-1.5%
ap-southeast-1,A100,FP16,21000,19.4,340,0.0%
ap-southeast-1,A100,FP8,39000,11.2,620,-0.9%
ap-southeast-1,A100,INT8,40000,10.8,640,-1.6%
```
(throughput_rps is approx prompt-response units at a 512 seq baseline).

Megan Ortiz: what's the KV/prefix impact? we saw hits help a lot on chat flows.

Anya Patel: with KV prefix caching enabled (common prefixes cached): p99 improves ~15-22% for fp8 on H100 (p99 7.1 -> 5.9ms), tokens/s up ~18%. for int8 improvement is smaller (~10%). cold-start penalty for fp8 on H100 is ~+3ms for first tokens due to kernel module JIT, but steady state is better.

Zhou Li: any kernel fallbacks observed? did runtime flip to fused_attention or the safer path on some seq lengths?

Anya Patel: yes — at seq >= 2048 on A100 we saw the runtime revert to the safe mha (fallback) for INT8 which raised p99 by ~6ms. H100 kept fused kernels up to 4096 for fp8. We included a small heuristic to prefer fused on H100 when seq distribution median <1024.

Rajesh Nair: deployment/capacity ask: for a production route serving final answers at 1000 rps 512-seq, what's the sizing on each region with fp8 default and int8 as fallback?

Zhou Li: rough estimates based on tests: H100 (us-east-1): 1000 rps @512 -> reserve ~0.9 of a p50 GPU (so 1 GPU can handle ~1100 rps with fp8 steady state) -> recommend 3x for HA and spikes => 3 GPUs. A100 (ap-southeast-1): ~1 GPU handles ~650 rps fp8 -> recommend 5 GPUs for similar headroom. int8 fallback reduces needed GPUs by ~10% on A100 but watch quality window.

InfraBot: deploy-notice: rolled kernel-flag "prefer_fused_h100" to staging at 2167801400 (auto-picked on matched seq profile).

Megan Ortiz: thanks — any sample prompts where quality delta is largest? want to add to regression set.

Anya Patel: added top 40 failure prompts to /eval/regs/sierra14b_quant_fp8_int8_216780. highlights are long-context math and some tricky instruction paraphrases — int8 has the larger errors. I'll open a docs thread with recommended canary config (fp8 primary, int8 fallback, prefix cache enabled, canary 5% traffic). :white_check_mark:
